Removes `encounterProviders` lines in `past-visit/past-visit-details/past-visit-summary.component.tsx` (deleted in this commit) and in `past-visit/past-visit.resource.ts`.
3. **#2583**, "O3-5693: Trim queue entry representation to what the table renders", merged **2026-07-29** (commit `171573ddff78`). Removes the `encounterProviders` field from `repString` in `hooks/useQueueEntries.ts`.
4. **#2541**, "O3-5679: De-duplicate patient notes in previous visit tab", merged **2026-06-08** (commit `49a93f006e49`). Removes and adds `encounterProviders` lines in `past-visit/past-visit-details/past-visit-summary.component.tsx`.
